// 按照发现页的分类进行搜索
// @author: syiism
exploreUrl:
<js>
let res = [];
let _zwf = "※";
let numx = 3;

function push(title, url, num, g,action) {
    let j = {
    title: title,
    url: url,
    style: {
        layout_flexGrow: g == 0 ? g : 1,
        layout_flexBasisPercent: num
    }
  }
     if(action){
         j.action = action.action;
         j.name = action.name;
         j.type = action.type;
         j.chars = action.chars;
         j.viewName = action.viewName;
         j.default = action.default;      
     }     
     res.push(j)	
}

function zwf(len,numx,num) {
  if(len % numx !== 0) {
    let n = len % numx;
    let p = numx - n;
      
    for(let i=0;i<p;i++) {
      push(_zwf, '', num, 1,{
      "type":"button",
      "action":"java.toast('这是占位符')"});
    }
  }
}

// 大类
let defaultV = "漫画";
push("模式", "", 1, 1, {
  "type": "select",
  "chars": ["漫画", "里番"],
  "action": `switchMode(${'infoMap["模式"]'})`,
  "default": defaultV
});

if (infoMap["模式"] == "漫画") {
  var labels = getLabels(infoMap["模式"]);
  labels = JSON.parse(labels);
 
  // 子类1
  // 一级子类
  let groups = labels['groups'].map(x => x.type);
  push('分组', '', 0.45, 1, {
    "type": "select",
    "chars": groups,
    "action": `switchGroup("${infoMap['分组']}")`,
    "default": groups[0]
  });

  // 二级子类
  let _labels = {};
  let __labels = {};
  labels['groups'].forEach(x => {
    _labels[x.type] = x.labels.map(x=>x.cn+'('+x.count+')');
    x.labels.forEach(item => {
      const key = `${item.cn}(${item.count})`;
      __labels[key] = item.name;
    });
  });

  defaultV = _labels[groups[0]][0];
  push('标签', '', 0.45, 1, {
    "type": "select",
    "chars": _labels[infoMap['分组']],
    "action": `switchLabel("${infoMap['标签']}")`,
    "default": defaultV
  });

  // 子类2
  let chars2 = ["最新", "评分", "收藏", "浏览", "最早"];
  let _chars2 = {
    "最新": "latest",
    "评分": "rating",
    "收藏": "favorites",
    "浏览": "view_count",
    "最早": "oldest"
  };
  defaultV = chars2[0];
  push('排序', '', 0.45, 1, {
    "type": "select",
    "chars": chars2,
    "action": `switchLabel2("${infoMap['排序']}")`,
    "default": defaultV
  });

  // 子类3
  let chars3 = ['全部', '最近7天', '最近30天'];
  let _chars3 = {'全部': 'all', '最近7天': '7d', '最近30天': '30d'};
  defaultV = chars3[0]
  push('时间', '', 0.45, 1, {
    "type": "select",
    "chars": chars3,
    "action": `switchLabel3("${infoMap['时间']}")`,
    "default": defaultV
  });

  // 是否显示 bl
  push('bl  (点我切换)', '', 1, 1, {
    "type": "toggle",
    "chars": ["不显示", "显示"],
    "action": `isShowBl('');`,
    "default": "不显示"
  });
  
  let url = `https://macapi1.com/ehentai/galleries?page={{page}}&page_size=20&label=${__labels[infoMap['标签']]}&sort=${_chars2[infoMap['排序']]}&time_range=${_chars3[infoMap['时间']]}&show_bl=${infoMap['bl  (点我切换)'] == "不显示"?0:1}`;
  push('go，go，go！出发喽！', url, 1, 1, { });

} else if (infoMap["模式"] == "里番") {
  var labels = getLabels(infoMap["模式"]);
  labels = JSON.parse(labels);
  labels = labels['data'];
  // 子类
  let url = 'https://macapi1.com/anilist/works?page={{page}}&page_size=20&genre={genre}&sort=latest';
  for (let i = 0; i < labels.length; i ++) {
    push(
      labels[i].genre_zh+'('+labels[i].count+')', 
      url.replace(/{genre}/, labels[i].genre), 
      0.33, 1, {});
  }
 zwf(labels.length, 2, 0.33);
}

JSON.stringify(res);
</js>

}

}

}
